note: Re-judged 2026-10-20 (independent auditor, after 30aabfda88). RFC 3768 Section 7.1: "If the packet was not generated by the address owner (Priority does not equal 255 (decimal)), the receiver MUST drop the packet, otherwise continue processing." The cited producer onPacket changed only inside the VRRPv3 owner block (`if in.spec.IsOwner` after the v2 owner return): a group configured checksum rfc5798-compatible now records ReasonOwner and returns there. That block is unreachable for version 2 (the v2 owner returns above it, and groups.go refuses rfc5798-compatible on version 2), and the v2 address-list block below it (addressListMatches, ReasonAddressList, return unless adv.Priority == ownerPriority) is byte-identical. TestInstanceV2AddressListMismatchDrops (sender 250, dropped, no FSM event), TestInstanceV2AddressListMismatchFromOwnerContinues (sender 255, counted and delivered) and TestInstanceV2AddressListMatchReachesFSM still pin drop, continue and match; all three PASS at HEAD (go test -run under ./le job run). Verdict unchanged.
